welcome.title: Welcome to SpeakCore
welcome.body: In a few steps you'll set up your SpeakCore instance and create the owner account. No voice servers are installed yet.

mode.title: Choose system mode
mode.body: You can change this mode later.
mode.simpleDesc: Guided and focused on the essentials – recommended to get started.
mode.expertDesc: More detail and overrides for experienced administrators.

account.title: Create owner account
account.body: This account has full control over SpeakCore.
account.passwordHint: At least {min} characters, with upper- and lowercase letters and a digit.

errors.ownerExists: An account already exists. Setup cannot be run again.
errors.locked: Setup is locked (SETUP_LOCK). No owner can be created.
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.passwordWeak: The password does not meet the requirements.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign in with your owner account.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.

archived.hint: Archived servers are inactive and offer no lifecycle actions.

new.title: Connect existing TS3 server
new.hint: Credentials are stored encrypted and never shown in plain text.
new.name: Display name
new.queryPortHint: ServerQuery port (default 10011), not the voice port.
new.voicePortHint: Client voice port (default 9987). Optional, informational only.

status.title: Status
status.unreachableHint: The server could not be reached. Check host, port and credentials.
status.name: Server name
status.readonlyNote: Read-only. Start/stop, management and installation will follow later.

errors.hostBlocked: This host is not allowed for security reasons.
errors.virtualServerInvalid: The virtual server ID is invalid.
errors.credentialsRequired: Please enter a username and password.
errors.encryptionMissing: SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set – credentials cannot be stored securely.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.connectionFailed: Connection failed. Please check your details.

provision.title: Prepare resources
provision.intro: Prepares only the managed Docker network and volume.
provision.warnFlag: Docker write actions must be explicitly enabled in the agent (AGENT_DOCKER_WRITE_ENABLED).
provision.queryHost: Query address / host for health check (optional)
provision.queryHostHint1: SpeakCore later uses this address for the read-only TS3 status check.
provision.queryHostHint2: No port scan. No automatic detection.
provision.queryHostHint3: Without an address, TS3 reachability stays “not configured”.
provision.writeDisabledHint: Docker write actions are disabled in the agent. Set AGENT_DOCKER_WRITE_ENABLED=true deliberately only – and only if the agent is not publicly reachable and a token is set.
provision.unavailableHint: Docker is unavailable or the agent is unreachable. Nothing was changed.
provision.invalidHint: The inputs are invalid. Please check.
provision.rollbackHint: In this step, created resources are not removed automatically.
provision.auditHint: The action was recorded in the audit log (without secrets).
provision.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

managed.label: Managed (prepared)
managed.queryAddressLabel: Query address / host (for the read-only health check)
managed.queryAddressHint: Used only for the read-only health check. No port scan. Empty = not configured.
managed.prepareHintSecret: A secret is generated and stored encrypted.
managed.createHintNotStarted: The container is created but not started.
managed.createHintNoServer: The TS3 server will not be running afterwards.
managed.containerCreatedHint: Container created, but not started yet.
managed.licenseLabel: I confirm that I comply with / accept the TeamSpeak 3 license terms.
managed.licenseHint: SpeakCore only provides the management layer. You are responsible for complying with the TeamSpeak license. Starting sets the license confirmation required by the TS3 image.
managed.containerStoppedHint: Container exists, but is not running.
managed.nextStepHealthcheck: A TS3 status check will follow in a later step.
managed.stopConfirm: The TS3 container will be stopped. Data is preserved.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.intro: Deleting the volume removes the TS3 data irreversibly.
dangerZone.warnData: The volume contains the TS3 data.
dangerZone.warnContainerFirst: The container must be removed first.
dangerZone.warnOthersKept: Network, server record and credentials are kept.
dangerZone.confirmDataLossLabel: I confirm the irreversible data loss.
dangerZone.confirmBackupLabel: I have created a backup or do not need one.
dangerZone.volumeRemovedHint: Volume removed. Network, server record and credentials are kept.
dangerZone.networkShared: This network may be used by multiple SpeakCore servers.
dangerZone.networkOnlyIfUnused: Only remove it when no managed containers exist anymore.
dangerZone.networkOthersKept: Containers, volumes, server records and credentials are not deleted.
dangerZone.networkRecreatable: If a server is prepared again later, the network can be re-created.
dangerZone.confirmNetworkUnusedLabel: I confirm that no SpeakCore-managed containers use this network anymore.
dangerZone.laterSteps: Server-record archiving follows in its own step.

archive.title: Complete deprovisioning
archive.intro: Archive the server record (DB-only, no Docker action).
archive.hintNoDocker: This does not start, stop or delete any Docker resources.
archive.hintVisible: Archived records are kept for traceability.
archive.hintCredentials: Credentials are only deleted if you explicitly choose so.
archive.confirmArchiveLabel: I confirm archiving the server record.
archive.noActions: Archived – no further lifecycle actions available.

export.title: Export (read-only)
export.hintNoSecrets: The export contains no credentials or secrets.
export.hintAuditMaybe: The audit history can optionally be included.
export.hintNoRestore: This export is not a restore/backup of the TS3 data.

backup.title: Volume backup
backup.notActive: Real backups are not active yet.
backup.prereq: A real volume backup is possible once the container has been removed (status "Resources prepared").
backup.sensitive: TS3 backups can contain sensitive data.
backup.stoppedRecommended: A backup requires the container to be stopped/removed.
backup.notDownload: This is not a download or restore of the TS3 data.
backup.dangerIntro: Creates a real, read-only backup of the managed volume – stored server-side, not downloadable.
backup.hintDataBackup: Backs up the managed volume read-only as an archive on the server.
backup.hintSensitive: The backup file can contain sensitive TS3 data and is treated as confidential.
backup.hintNoRestore: No restore, no import and no download via the browser.
backup.hintServerSide: Target directory and image are defined server-side (no free path/image).
backup.confirmSensitiveLabel: I understand the backup may contain sensitive TS3 data.
backup.confirmStorageLabel: I am responsible for storing the backup securely.
backup.confirmStoppedLabel: The container is stopped or removed.

backupList.title: Backups (view only)
backupList.sensitiveHint: Backup files can contain sensitive TS3 data.
backupList.readOnlyHint: No download, no restore, no delete – visibility only.
backupList.checksumHint: SHA-256 verifies integrity – it is not encryption and not a signature.
backupList.downloadHint: Download only after a valid checksum verification, with confirmations – every delivery is audited.
backupList.deleteHint: Deletion targets individual backup files, is irreversible and requires multiple confirmations – no rotation, no bulk delete.

delete.warnIrreversible: This deletion is irreversible – the backup file and its metadata will be removed.
delete.warnOnlyBackup: This is the only known backup of this server.
delete.warnNotVerified: This backup has not been successfully verified in this view.
delete.warnMetadata: The metadata is missing or invalid.
delete.warnArchived: The server is archived – this backup could be the last data source.
delete.confirmDeletionLabel: I understand this backup will be deleted.
delete.confirmOnlyCopyLabel: I understand this may be the only copy.
delete.confirmNoRestoreLabel: I understand no restore is possible without a backup.

deleteResult.metadataDeleteFailed: The backup file was deleted, but the metadata file could not be removed.
deleteResult.notManaged: Deletion is only available for managed servers.
deleteResult.onlyCopyRequired: Please confirm this may be the only copy.
deleteResult.restoreWarnRequired: Please confirm no restore is possible without a backup.
deleteResult.typedMismatch: Please type the confirmation phrase exactly.
deleteResult.rateLimited: Too many delete actions – please try again later.
deleteResult.backupDirUnavailable: The backup directory is unavailable on the agent.

verifyResult.valid: Verification successful: the checksum matches (backup unchanged).
verifyResult.mismatch: Warning: the checksum does NOT match – the file was modified or is corrupted.
verifyResult.metadataMissing: Verification not possible: the metadata file is missing.
verifyResult.checksumMissing: Verification not possible: the metadata contains no checksum (older backup).
verifyResult.backupNotFound: Verification not possible: the backup file was not found.
verifyResult.metadataInvalid: Verification not possible: the metadata is invalid.
verifyResult.backupDirUnavailable: The backup directory is unavailable on the agent.
verifyResult.notManaged: Verification is only available for managed servers.

backupList.dirUnavailable: The backup directory is unavailable on the agent.
backupList.unreachable: Agent unreachable – backups cannot be listed.

download.hintSensitive: Backup files can contain sensitive TS3 data – you are responsible for storing them securely.
download.hintReverify: The checksum is re-verified server-side before the download.
download.hintNoRestore: Restore is not implemented – this is only the file download.
download.confirmSensitiveLabel: I understand the backup may contain sensitive TS3 data.
download.confirmStorageLabel: I am responsible for storing the file securely.

backfill.hint: The backup file is not modified – only the metadata file is extended with a SHA-256 checksum (integrity, not encryption; the backup remains sensitive).

backfillResult.updated: Checksum was added – the backup can now be verified and downloaded.
backfillResult.metadataMissing: Cannot add checksum: the metadata file is missing.
backfillResult.metadataInvalid: Cannot add checksum: the metadata is invalid.
backfillResult.backupNotFound: Cannot add checksum: the backup file was not found.
backfillResult.notManaged: This action is only available for managed servers.
backfillResult.backupDirUnavailable: The backup directory is unavailable on the agent.

downloadResult.notManaged: Download is only available for managed servers.
downloadResult.sensitiveDataRequired: Please confirm the backup may contain sensitive data.
downloadResult.storageRequired: Please confirm responsibility for secure storage.
downloadResult.typedMismatch: Please type the confirmation phrase exactly.
downloadResult.rateLimited: Too many downloads – please try again later.
downloadResult.mismatch: Download blocked: the checksum does NOT match – file modified or corrupted.
downloadResult.checksumMissing: Download blocked: the metadata contains no checksum (older backup).
downloadResult.metadataMissing: Download blocked: the metadata file is missing.
downloadResult.metadataInvalid: Download blocked: the metadata is invalid.
downloadResult.backupNotFound: Download blocked: the backup file was not found.
downloadResult.backupDirUnavailable: The backup directory is unavailable on the agent.

deprovision.title: Deprovisioning (not active yet)
deprovision.notActive: Removing volume/network is not enabled yet.
deprovision.dataLoss: Deleting the volume later means irreversible data loss – back up first.
deprovision.later: Actual deletion follows in a later step with additional confirmation.

managed.removeHintKeep: Container present or prepared, but not running.
managed.removeConfirm2: Volume, network and stored credentials are kept.
managed.removeConfirm3: The TS3 server is not started or stopped.
managed.removeConfirm4: If the container is still running, stop it first.
managed.restartHint: Restart = stop first, then start. A health check afterwards is recommended.
managed.restartConfirm1: The TS3 container is stopped first and then started again.
managed.restartLicenseLabel: I confirm that I continue to comply with / accept the TeamSpeak 3 license terms.

notice.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

notice.conflict: Name conflict with an unmanaged resource.

notice.dataLossRequired: Please explicitly confirm the data loss.

notice.backupCreated: Volume backup was created server-side (not downloadable).
notice.sensitiveDataRequired: Please confirm the backup may contain sensitive data.

error.conflict: Name conflict with an unmanaged resource.

dashboard.placeholderHint: Voice server management will follow in a later step.

systemcheck.subtitle: Preflight & Capacity Advisor
systemcheck.intro: This assessment estimates what your system can handle.
systemcheck.demoNotice: Example data – no real system measurement is performed yet.

docker.managedOnlyNote: Read-only. Only resources created by SpeakCore are detected; foreign Docker resources are not managed.

network.title: Network
network.noExternalTest: No external reachability tests are performed. Public reachability (ports/NAT) will be checked separately later.

details.proxmoxVm: Proxmox VM – recommended for production installs
